$comment: Offline supporting asset for the Gauge Contract described in proposal.md. The contract is a conceptual governance state machine for standard-setting in the Jing-Zhang AI Innovation Belt; it is not a statutory instrument, procurement specification, or implementation approval.
title: Gauge Contract — machine-readable standard-power state machine
title_zh: 标准权契约——标准制定权的机器可读状态机

contract_id.description: Unique identifier of one standard-setting process, e.g. GAUGE-CONTRACT-2026-001.

standard_topic.description: The standard topic being defined, e.g. open-data interoperability for edge-compute cabinets.

state.description: Lifecycle state of the standard-setting process. Transitions require the human gate in human_gate except DRAFT->REVIEW (submission opens publicly).

proposer.description: Who may initiate: anyone or any agent. Submission is public from DRAFT onward.

evidence_gate.description: REVIEW stage: citations must be verifiable and boundaries disclosed before professional + community review proceeds.

final_judgement_gate.description: MERGE stage: only a human professional team may merge a standard into consensus. Agents never auto-merge.

dispute_gate.description: ROLLBACK stage: a dispute is reviewed by reviewers not involved in the initial review; no majority coercion.

evidence_level.description: Evidence ladder: each decision level may only rely on evidence at or above its required level. E0 concept claims cannot support deepening decisions; E3+ require on-site or endorsed data not yet available.

synthetic.description: true when the contract record is a design-target example, not a live governance record.

unmeasured_fields.description: Fields intentionally null / not yet measured, recorded as assets rather than hidden. For this conceptual package these include on-site observation, professional endorsement and pilot outcomes.

public_commitments.description: Four verifiable public commitments: 1) any topic is publicly searchable once DRAFT; 2) REVIEW citations traceable; 3) MERGE executed only by humans; 4) ROLLBACK halts publication and transfers to human review.

disclaimer.const: Conceptual governance mechanism proposed for professional deepening. Does not constitute statutory planning, government decision, procurement specification, investment commitment, or engineering feasibility conclusion.
